quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer base (annual report): the company says its customers include four of the world's top five consumer-electronics brands, the world's top five pure-EV makers and four of the world's top five cloud service providers. It says its expansion projects for optical modules (including optical chips) and AI PCBs are proceeding as planned with capacity ramping smoothly, and that its scaled supply capability can match the growing procurement demand of overseas mainstream cloud vendors. Production facilities are in 15 countries and regions across Asia, North America, Europe and Africa.

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): R&D spend RMB 1,431,775,054.82 in 2025, up 13.02%, 3.57% of revenue; 5,074 R&D staff. Optical R&D projects and their status: 1.6T OSFP DR8 with a 3nm DSP and self-developed EML, and 800G QDD DR8&2xFR4 Gen2 (20% lower power than Gen1) in small-batch trial production; 1.6T OSFP 2xFR4 and 2LR4 EML modules, 1.6T DR8&2xFR4 silicon-photonics modules 'with BRCM and Xphor PIC' and 'with Marvell and Xphor PIC' (the latter to use the short delivery cycle of Marvell's 3nm DSP to answer urgent orders from global cloud and AI companies, and to seize what the company calls the 2026 first year of 1.6T volume ramp), and 800G DR4++ in sample making / verification; 800G AEC (active electrical cable) samples delivered to customers and 1.6T AEC in sample making; 3.2T OSFP-XD DR8, 6.4T/3.2T NPO for scale-up, 6.4T/12.8T XPO and a 1.6T LRO module (30% lower power than a 1.6T design with DSPs on both ends) in scheme evaluation; a 6.4T ELSFP external-laser module for CPO/NPO switches using its own CW laser in development. Chips: 212Gbaud EML for single-wave 400G (3.2T/6.4T modules) in design optimisation and sample making; 106Gbaud differential EML and CWDM/LWDM EML chips in sample making. AI PCB research includes 0-4mil back-drill stub length required by a leading AI customer (the company says the industry capability is 2-6mil) and 11-step HDI.
quarterly_data.figure: R&D RMB 1,431,775,054.82 (+13.02%), 3.57% of revenue; 1.6T DR8 in small-batch trial production; 3.2T/6.4T in evaluation

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: AI PCB and optical capacity (annual report): Multek can make ultra-high-layer PCBs of 78 layers and above and 7-step thick-board HDI, and the company says it decisively invested over 10 hundred million US dollars to expand high-end capacity. Construction in progress was RMB 2,345,985,416.22 at end-2025. Major projects: high-end AI PCB project (budget RMB 70.00 hundred million; cumulative input 6.57% of budget, progress 3.52%); optical module manufacturing line project (budget RMB 18.00 hundred million; 16.50%; RMB 265,534,507.25 at year-end); multilayer circuit board plant construction (budget RMB 18.75 hundred million; progress 93.78%). Investing cash outflow rose 85.14%, which the company attributes to the Source Photonics and GMD acquisitions and capacity expansion in optical modules (including optical chips) and AI PCBs.
quarterly_data.figure: high-end AI PCB project budget RMB 70.00 hundred million (3.52% progress); optical module line budget RMB 18.00 hundred million (16.50%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dongshan Precision annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 work plan (annual report): use Source Photonics' vertical integration to make sure new optical-chip capacity is released as planned and keep raising chip yield and performance; expand batch-delivery capability and market share in 800G and 1.6T high-speed optical modules; push construction of the new AI PCB base to start production and raise supply of high-layer-count and HDI PCBs for AI servers. The company says Source Photonics' CW laser is in scaled mass production and its single-wave 400G EML chip project is progressing on plan.
